name: Technology Committee Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Technology Committee will conduct a
  Regular Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY HALL
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Thursday, November21, 2019
  4:00 PM

  AGENDA

  1)  Public Comment

  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the

  Committee on any item not listed on the agenda.

  2)  Technology Committee Structure

  a. Discussion on the structure of the Technology Committee meetings from the

  Committee members’ perspective

  3)  Website Portal Preview

  a. A preliminary look at the proposed eGov portal

  4)  Fiber to the Premise Initiative

  a. A brief update on the status of the FTTP initiative

  5)  Adjournment

cj& .jHuma Ahmed City Clerk

  Posted: November 18, 2019

Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable efforts to
 accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call (310) 285-1014
  (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (flY). Providing at least forty-eight (48) hours advance notice will help to
 ensure availability of services. City Hall, including Conference Room 280A, is wheelchair accessible.
